title: A head that first adds graphyard.trial.Dockerfile runs its trial in the image it builds
description: A fixture repository without graphyard.trial.Dockerfile gets a head that adds one (an ENV and a stub gofake over the trial image). With a stub docker first on PATH that reads --file the way docker does, the real merge trial builds the head's Dockerfile from its path inside the context worktree and runs the preMerge check 'gofake verify' in that image.

steps.name: a head first introducing the trial Dockerfile builds it and runs its checks in it
